R712.note: Unsandboxed GroovyShell replaced by JEXL with a block-all JexlSandbox(false) and newInstance disabled, the appropriate engine-level fix; the engine swap means stored formulas relying on Groovy-only syntax or method calls now fail, which the write-up states and is inherent to closing the sink.

R713.note: Explicit position >= record.size() check before the unchecked operator[] write closes the OOB write; skipping out-of-range edits only affects inputs that were undefined behaviour before and is stated.

R714.note: jwt.decode now takes the key and a fixed algorithms allowlist with InvalidTokenError mapped to 401; the new JWT_SIGNING_KEY env var and HS256 assumption are stated openly as configuration the service must match.

R715.note: proc_open array form bypasses the shell so $term is one literal argv entry, with -F and -- retained; identical arguments and output handling, no behaviour change for legitimate terms.

R716.note: orderByRaw replaced by orderBy fed from a server-side column allowlist and asc/desc reduction, which the contract calls for; the two allowlisted columns are a guess and unlisted sorts silently fall back to the default, but that is stated plainly.

R717.note: Single-pass RFC 4515 escaping of the five filter metacharacters before concatenation into DirectorySearcher.Filter; no allowlist added, all other characters pass through, null/NotFound path unchanged.

R718.note: strcat replaced by snprintf bounded to sizeof(path) with a correct truncation check returning -1; produces the identical string for every filename that fit before and rejects only those that previously overflowed.

R719.note: f-string interpolation replaced by a :date_filter bind parameter passed to connection.execute; same query shape, same result iteration, same driver-side failure behaviour.

R720.note: Statement replaced by PreparedStatement with setString(1, data); result handling, logging and resource cleanup are unchanged.

R721.note: The {0}/filterArgs overload lets the JDK LDAP provider escape the value, closing the injection, but the write-up passes SearchControls with SUBTREE_SCOPE where the original passed null (default ONELEVEL_SCOPE), broadening the search while incorrectly claiming it preserves the original scope.

R722.note: filepath.Rel containment check correctly rejects '..'-prefixed results including the uploads-backup sibling, and accepts uploadsDir itself and every genuine descendant exactly as before.

R723.note: Widening to long with multiplyExact closes the int wrap, but the added MAX_BUFFER_BYTES=10,000,000 cap is a new restriction the contract does not call for and rejects with 400 requests inside the documented per-field ranges (e.g. count=10001, size=1000) that previously allocated fine.
